title: stipa pennata var. pulcherrima
intro: Stipa pennata var. pulcherrima, commonly known as Golden Feather Grass or Golden Hair Grass, is a variety of the Stipa pennata plant, which is a type of flowering perennial grass. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stipa pennata var. pulcherrima include wound healing, immune system modulation, and antiseptic effects, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
